_doc: Edit tiles only. Fields: id (short key), title (Marathi label), headline (one line, what matters now), note (optional second line), state (ok = green, warn = amber, bad = red, anything else = grey), updated_at (UTC ISO time of the change), wide (optional true = full width). Keep each text short. Set updated_at to the real change time. No rate-source names.
